deviations: None from the approach. The docs for E4a/E4bc (the first-merge row, STAY_NEAR_MS, P-3..P-7, 13 §6, 13 §4.4, 03 sequencing) were already in place, so E4d added only its own: 15 §7 variants (7 rows, source line), 15 §10 SHORT_PACE row, 05 §8.5a P-19, 03 PaceRule.short?/shortOf/shortForm (contract prose and v1.2 field list). 03 is normative: this amends it (PaceRule gains an optional field; ManeuverRule, the contract the renderer sees, is unchanged).
limitations: E4d savings fall short of C2's estimate on every pod (Quasar 215 s vs 251 s, Pulsar 107 s vs 145 s): C2's model also shortened first merges, which have no short form here (the transformation floors them), and a real re-schedule keeps the captain plate minimums and sequencing. This is a ceiling for E5, not a result; the pacingBuilt test asserts only saved > 0 for E4d.

The Built E4d row's 'after' wraps variants to prefer the short form; since a short form replaces a variant's name, a beamed close's `beamed` variant name becomes `beamed-short` in that run only. Nothing in the app does this.
